name: Jackson
gaps: Parcels are Tax_Parcels Tax Parcels (official Jackson County GA AGOL) (https://services8.arcgis.com/bcbi4lYRFOsss0F5/arcgis/rest/services/Tax_Parcels/FeatureServer/9). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
Market value is the sum of FMVRES, FMVCOM, and FMVACC. The total stays empty when those components are zero.
Source query returned 6661 rows; 6659 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 tax is REST, sale is HTML-only, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Pass 2 sale date and price are HTML-only and were not copied.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
